notes.title: February 5 UPDATE
notes.content:
This Updates touch upon Materials, Objectives, and LODs levels to improve FPS. The following areas have been touched upon and improved:
• Materials Update
	o Walls updated in Levels 1, 2, 3, 5, & 6.
        o Materials in Level 2 have been improvised.
	o LODs updated in Levels 3 & 5
	o Appliance materials updated in Level 5
• Objectives in the GFCI has been improved in 2nd Level
• Updated Fire Alarm & Sounds on all Levels have been touched upon as well as stairwell in Level 6.
• Fire Extinguisher Time has been reduced and now require a side to side motion for the objective to be complete. 
• Fire Extinguisher A in Level 5 has been fixed, previously mesh disappears, now has been fixed to render properly.
• Lighting in Level 3 has been brightened. 
• Interaction with Fire Alarm in all Levels now record collision
• Updated player speed 
• Ending Video brightened for better viewing
• Fixed Interactable objects in Level 1
